blocks.expr: const land = d.steps.find(s => s.name.startsWith('landed')).at_s; const f = s => `t+${(s.at_s - land).toFixed(0).padStart(3)} s  ${s.name}`; return d.steps.filter(s => s.at_s >= land).map(s => f(s) + (s.sample ? `   GET /quote → ${s.sample.status}` : '') + (s.statuses ? `   ${s.statuses.length} requests → ${[...new Set(s.statuses)].join(',')}` : ''));
